newsitem.title: CHINA: China's light industry to set up 100 huge firms.
newsitem.headline: China's light industry to set up 100 huge firms.

text.p: China light industry authorities plan to set up 100 large-scale enterprises with annual sales of more than 2.0 billion yuan ($240 million) in 1996-2000, officials and state media said on Monday.
"We want to form large-scale enterprises to improve competitiveness against foreign companies," said an official of the Chinese Association of Light Industry.
The government would fund profitable state companies to look into merger and acquisitions involving loss-making firms, he said but gave no further details.
The authorities would also support large-scale firms to issue bonds and shares to raise money and to obtain more rights to engage in foreign trade, the China Securities said.
The gross output value of China's light industry was expected to hit 3.01 trillion yuan in 1997, up 15 percent from 2.62 trillion yuan last year.
